posts.author: 0xb20 ✧ WOJAK.LTD ✧ base.eth
posts.text:
Two years ago we tried launching a memecoin.
It was called WojakLTD.
It didn't exactly become the next Bitcoin. 💀
But apparently I didn't learn my lesson.

So here we are again.
This time on Solana.
This time with @bloblat 🧪
We survived the first night.
We even drew a pretty clean breakout. 📈
Now comes the hard part:

— find buyers
— build the project
— keep shipping
— try not to die
If only it was as easy as drawing a breakout line. Ahah.

But honestly? I think the fun part is just getting started.

Welcome to the lab. 🟢
 $BLOB is alive.

#BLOB #Solana #Crypto #Memecoin #Web3 #GameFi #BuildInPublic
